in_marathi.name: Bherulal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bherulal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bherulal is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Brahma's Leap'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Brahma, who is the creator of the universe. According to mythology, Brahma took a leap to create the world. The name Bherulal represents courage, creation, and divine wisdom.
